name: building-knowledge-graph
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to build their knowledge graph — a knowledge/ folder of markdown pages about the work a person, team, or company does (clients, offerings, processes, people, tools, policies) that the AI maintains, following the Open Knowledge Format. Triggers: "build my knowledge graph", "set up my knowledge graph", "create my knowledge graph", "start my knowledge graph", "upgrade my knowledge graph", "add the records: convention to my SCHEMA.md", "replace the Answering my questions section", "set up my business knowledge base", starting the knowledge graph lab. NOT the AI Registry: for "set up my registry" or an inventory of workflows, skills, and agents, use scaffolding-registry. NOT the Build step of the AI Workflow Framework: for building a workflow's building blocks, use the build skill. Re-running on an existing knowledge/ bundle fills gaps; it never rebuilds.
